NonFreeNet.en-US: A package's scans come from carriers' sites and from tracking services such as 17TRACK, through Peek's own server, which is free software. A new lookup can need Cloudflare's Turnstile check, sign-in can use Google, and directions to a pickup point open Google Maps.

TetheredNet.en-US: Works only with peektracker.com. Its server is free software that anyone can host, but the app has no setting to use another one.

Tracking.en-US: Sends which screens and actions are used to the project's own Umami analytics, with no setting to turn it off. A new lookup can need Cloudflare's Turnstile check, which reads browser and network signals.
